title: VoroPlex: A Python Framework for Multi-Threaded and Differentiable Voronoi Tessellation
abstract: arXiv:2611.33829v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Voronoi tessellations are widely used in computational physics, for example to measure local structure in particle systems and to generate meshes. We present VoroPlex, an open-source Python package for computing Voronoi tessellations in two and three dimensions. VoroPlex is built on the multi-threaded version of the C++ library Voro++, so that large tessellations can be computed in parallel. The package also makes the tessellation differentiable. Each Voronoi vertex is labeled by the generators that define it, and VoroPlex uses these labels to compute the derivative of the vertex with respect to the positions of these generators. PyTorch can therefore compute gradients of quantities such as cell areas, volumes, and interface areas with respect to the generator positions, so that these quantities can be optimized using standard gradient-based methods. translated_title: VoroPlex：一个支持多线程与可微计算的多维Voronoi镶嵌Python框架
translated_abstract: Voronoi镶嵌在计算物理中应用广泛，例如可用于测量粒子系统的局部结构以及生成网格。我们提出了VoroPlex，一个用于计算二维和三维Voronoi镶嵌的开源Python软件包。VoroPlex基于C++库Voro++的多线程版本构建，因此能够并行计算大规模的镶嵌。该软件包还使镶嵌具备了可微性：每个Voronoi顶点都由定义它的生成元进行标记，VoroPlex利用这些标记来计算顶点相对于生成元位置的导数。因此，PyTorch可以计算诸如单元格面积、体积以及界面面积等物理量相对于生成元位置的梯度，从而可以使用标准的基于梯度的方法对这些量进行优化。该软件包还包含用于提取单元格组之间界面的工具等。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了VoroPlex，一个基于多线程Voro++的开源Python框架，不仅能并行计算二维和三维Voronoi镶嵌，还首次使镶嵌结果可微分，允许借助PyTorch对单元格面积、体积、界面面积等几何量进行基于梯度的优化。
